notes: Each UK nation has its own deprivation index. Ranks and scores aren't comparable across nations — there isn't a single UK deprivation league table.
Deprivation is shown as context, not as an explanation. Many factors sit behind differences in life expectancy.

england.source: English indices of deprivation 2025, File 10 v2
england.note: Rank of average IMD score; 1 = most deprived in England. Not comparable with WIMD.
